messages:
tess: Quick sync to lock landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private before the launch post and webinar promos. Aim: distinct lead lines, one short benchmark teaser per page, and a form that surfaces technical interest.
arjun: Copy framework idea: single-page hero = product promise (deliverable), then three mode cards with 1-line benefit + 1-line how (no jargon). CTAs: Hosted -> 'Start free trial', Dedicated/Private -> 'Request demo'.
felix: Benchmark approach: public teaser only (e.g. 'Typical cost reduction vs baseline: 25-55%*'). Asterisk -> gated modal with methodology and exact numbers. Avoid absolute claims in hero.
raina: For lead routing, add hidden form fields: utm_campaign, ad_variant, preferred_mode. Include a checkbox: 'Send detailed benchmark results and runbook' that sets lead_tag=benchmark_tech in the payload. We'll forward to CRM with pipeline hint. Example URL: 
``?utm_source=ads&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=tri_mode_q3&ad_variant=bench_or_reliability``
marc: Sales ops: on Dedicated & Private add a micro-FAQ: 'Do you offer SLAs and private networking?' -> short answer and a 'Talk to sales' link. Add a tiny throughput callout (range) but put details in gated doc.
tess: Webinar plan: two promo angles — Benchmark Deep Dive (bench-led) and Production Reliability (ops-led). Ads map to landing anchors and set ad_variant hidden value so we can A/B nurture.
arjun: I can draft three hero headlines + two subheads per mode by noon. Felix, can you prepare the benchmark teaser copy + one-line qualifier to appear right under the hero?
felix: Yup. I'll keep qualifiers like 'Measured on open model Z, 1k-2k context; results vary.' Full details in gated material.
raina: Dev ticket: form must push to webhook /api/lead-intake with payload fields: name, email, company, preferred_mode, utm_campaign, ad_variant, benchmark_opt_in, lead_source=web. Tag #web-forms.
marc: Also request an AE tag for leads with benchmark_opt_in checked and company.size > 200. That helps prioritization.
tess: Timeline: publish landing page Monday, launch post Tuesday, paid promos Wed-Fri, webinar in two weeks. Who needs more time?
arjun: On track.
felix: Need 24 hrs for QC on benchmark wording.
raina: Dev ticket in flight.
marc: Sales snippets ready by EOD.
tess: Great. If no blockers we'll lock copy tonight and hand to web engineers tomorrow. Drop urgent issues here. :rocket:
